audience.text: Developers needing fast, zero-dependency image format detection and metadata extraction for .NET applications.

capabilities.text: Detects 14 image formats by reading only signature bytes using ImageProbe.DetectFormat() without decoding pixels.
capabilities.title: Format detection

capabilities.text: ImageProbe.Probe() reads width, height, bit depth, and frame count directly from file headers for supported formats.
capabilities.title: Header probing

capabilities.text: Accurately counts frames in GIF, ICO, TIFF, and multi-page DJVU by walking their container structures.
capabilities.title: Multi-frame counting

capabilities.text: Provides both synchronous and asynchronous entry points (Probe/ProbeAsync, ProbeFile/ProbeFileAsync) for non-blocking operations.
capabilities.title: Async support

capabilities.text: Returns partial ImageInfo with only Format set for malformed or truncated files instead of throwing exceptions.
capabilities.title: Robust error handling

capabilities.text: Zero required third-party package dependencies; all format parsing is implemented natively within the library.
capabilities.title: No dependencies

limitations.text: Only performs format detection and header probing; does not decode, render, edit, or convert images.
Frame count is only real for GIF, ICO, TIFF, and multi-page DJVU; other formats report fixed 1.
Classic (non-placeable) WMF is detected but not dimensioned due to missing bounding rectangle in its header.
DICOM parsing stops at the first undefined-length element like sequences or encapsulated pixel data.
CDR support is planned but not yet implemented; no CdrFormatHandler exists in the current source tree.

problems_solved.text: Avoids full image decoding just to determine format and basic properties like dimensions and bit depth.
Provides unified support for 14 image formats including PSD, EMF/WMF, DICOM, AVIF, and HEIC/HEIF without external dependencies.
Enables safe, unattended processing of untrusted files by returning partial results instead of throwing exceptions on malformed input.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Imaging.Foss is a free, open-source .NET library for image format detection and header probing without any dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of 14 supported formats is implied but not explicitly listed in facts.
Whether AVIF/HEIC grid images report full canvas dimensions is described in README but not verified by facts.
Exact behavior for indirect (multi-file) DJVM documents is described in README but not confirmed by facts.
The specific DICOM transfer syntaxes supported beyond Implicit VR LE and Explicit VR LE/BLE are not detailed in facts.
Whether non-placeable WMF detection returns null or 0 for dimensions is described in README but not confirmed by facts.
The exact behavior of Probe() on unseekable streams is described in README but not directly verified by facts.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Build the solution using 'dotnet build Aspose.Imaging.Foss.sln' and run tests with 'dotnet test Aspose.Imaging.Foss.sln'.

workflows.name: Continuous integration
workflows.text: CI runs on Ubuntu and Windows using workflows in .github/workflows/.

workflows.name: Release
workflows.text: Tagged pushes trigger the release workflow at .github/workflows/release.yml to build and publish the package.
